elements.description: Who started whom in a run of agents: cards joined by connectors, with costs, times and folding.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the tree list's name

properties.name: root
properties.description: The orchestrator, with its sub-agents nested in `children` – the whole run as one tree

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: Ids of folded branches. Changed by the fold buttons unless tc-collapsed-change is prevented

properties.name: now
properties.description: The clock for running times, in epoch ms – unset uses an internal clock

properties.name: formatCost
properties.description: Formats every cost – defaults to dollars, e.g. "$0.42"

properties.name: resolver
properties.type: ((agent: TreeAgent, action: AgentTreeResolution) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description:
Called with each answer (as well as tc-resolve). May return a promise: the answer's buttons wait, and if it
rejects the window stays open and says so

properties.name: selectable
properties.description: The agents' names are buttons that fire tc-select (the whole card stays clickable for a pointer)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-collapsed-change
events.description: A branch was folded or unfolded (detail: { collapsed: string[] }); cancelable

events.name: tc-select
events.description: A card was clicked, or its name pressed (detail: { agent: TreeAgent }); shown as a button with `selectable`

events.name: tc-resolve
events.description: An answer from the "needs you" or "failed" window (detail: { agent: TreeAgent, action: "approve" | "reject" | "retry" | "dismiss" })

props.name: root
props.description: The orchestrator, with its sub-agents nested in `children` – the whole run as one tree

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
Ids of folded branches. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps them, starting from
`defaultCollapsed`

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Ids of the branches folded at first when `collapsed` isn't controlled

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with every folded branch's id after a branch is folded or unfolded

props.name: onResolve
props.description:
An answer from the "needs you" or "failed" window: approve or reject a waiting agent, retry or dismiss a failed
one. May return a promise: the answer's buttons wait, and if it rejects the window stays open and says so

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A click on a card – e.g. to open its log

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the tree list's name (default "Agents")
